# Arpilo

> Arpilo is a small studio in Victoria, BC. We design and make Christmas ornaments in silky colours with raised gold detail, ring dishes and trays, and an arbutus lantern, and we choose natural stone hearts and bracelets one by one. Order online and we post anywhere in Canada.

- Shop: https://arpilo.ca/ (more pieces on Etsy: https://www.etsy.com/shop/ArpiloStudio)
- Where: Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. An online shop; no walk-in store.
- Delivery: anywhere in Canada, tracked, from Victoria, so no customs or duty. CA$5 flat, free from CA$30. Dispatched in 1-3 business days. Canada only for now.
- Damaged or faulty on arrival: photograph the box and the piece the day it arrives and email us; we replace it.
- Payment on arpilo.ca: PayPal (card, PayPal or Pay in 4).
- Contact: hello@arpilo.ca
- Now: 25% off everything until 5 January, except the Arbutus lantern.
